A screenshot was captured of the confirmation page showing "Contact created" with the details.

Created quotation S00023 for customer 'fwod30-n3 Bench Customer'. Confirmed quotation S00023 by clicking the Confirm button. The order now shows status "Sales Order" (the active/checked stage in the statusbar). The order reference remains S00023, visible as the heading on the record.

Opened sales order S00023 for customer 'fwod30-n3 Bench Customer', clicked the Cancel button (Send and cancel), accepted the confirmation. The status bar now shows "Cancelled" as the active status, confirming the cancellation succeeded. The order reference remains S00023.
